note: Digests of the pickled model artifacts. verify_artifact() checks a file against this map before joblib.load() runs (audit findings C-4 / M-3). In production, serve this file from a read-only path via CYBERGUARD_MODEL_MANIFEST and sign it (CYBERGUARD_MODEL_MANIFEST_SIG).
environment_note: Interpreter + library versions the .pkl artifacts were serialised with. check_serialization_env() compares the running process against this to catch cross-version unpickle hazards (PP-C5); a scikit-learn minor mismatch is a hard startup failure in production. Regenerate after retraining with `python -m cyberguard_api.services.model_loader --generate` on the build image.
